description: The only machine-readable Pakistani price panel — every urban centre and essential item the Bureau prices weekly, accrued locally because the Bureau itself does not keep the series.

tools.name: file_get
tools.description: Fetch one annexure, report, or CPI annex file by exact filename. Formats: .xlsx for the 44 most recent weekly releases (2025-10-23 onward) and .pdf for the other 104 -- so the text-layer PDF path covers 70% of the panel and is not optional. Never construct this filename; take it from `releases`. Required: filename.

params.name: filename
params.description: Exact file name including extension, taken verbatim from the release index. Two rows carry a filename whose embedded date DISAGREES with the index `date` field (date=21-08-2025 -> Annex_13.08.2025.pdf, an 8-day discrepancy; date=04-06-2025 -> Annex.pdf), so the index date is authoritative and the filename is opaque.

tools.name: index_get
tools.description: Fetch the release-index page. THE ONLY ENUMERATOR -- release URLs are UNCONSTRUCTIBLE: 35 distinct annexure filename shapes across 148 rows (top shape covers only 53), including one `Annex.pdf` with no date at all, plus load-bearing typos (SumarySPI, SummaryReport, USCCP, Annexture). A guessed URL returns a clean HTTP 404, never a soft 200. This endpoint's html_extract returns the raw file-link list; the authoritative date-paired index comes from the hand-written JS-literal parser in `releases`.

novel_features.name: Cross-city price spread
novel_features.description: See the cheapest and dearest city for any essential item in any week, and how that gap has moved over time.

novel_features.name: Single-item multi-city series
novel_features.description: Follow one item's price across named cities and weeks, with missing weeks shown as gaps rather than filled.

novel_features.name: Custom re-weighted basket
novel_features.description: Build your own price index over any subset of items using the weight vector PBS republishes every week.

novel_features.name: Weight-vector drift
novel_features.description: Read the item weight vector for any release, diff two releases, and check the totals sum to 100.

novel_features.name: Extraction verification
novel_features.description: Audit parsed cell values against the source's own arithmetic invariants, including the weight totals and min-avg-max ordering.

novel_features.name: Coverage and gap map
novel_features.description: Show which releases exist upstream, which the local store holds, and every hole named as a hole.

novel_features.name: Upstream revision detector
novel_features.description: Detect releases the Bureau has rewritten, re-pointed, or deleted since you captured them.

novel_features.name: Top movers from levels
novel_features.description: Rank every item in a release by percent change recomputed from price levels, nationally or per city, with outliers flagged.
